work_items: ["Communicate the data information policy on the service application or web page.", "Maintain procedures for GDPR compliance.", "Plan the required steps for handling large volumes of user data requests.", "Clearly communicate resource reallocation or waiting times that may result from large user data requests."]

requirement: Systems identifies users with special need and has feature to inform terminal service provider of required help. Systems also need to be available to tract special need aids inside the Terminal.
title: Identification and Support of Users with Special Needs
description: As a user with special needs, I want the system to identify me and inform the terminal service provider of the help I require, so that the provider can arrange that help.
work_items: ["The system shall identify users with special needs.", "The system shall provide a feature that informs the terminal service provider of the help required by an identified user with special needs.", "The system shall support tracking of special-needs aids inside the terminal."]

requirement: Registered User must be able to maintain his/her session information for at least 60 minutes of inactive session before the system prompts him to log out of the system. The registered user must be provided with all the options of the E-store regardless of the time when he/she logs in.
title: Session Continuity and Consistent Store Access
description: As a registered user, I want my session information retained during periods of inactivity and access to all E-store options regardless of when I log in, so that I can use the E-store without time-based restrictions.
work_items: ["Maintain the registered user's session information for at least 60 minutes of inactivity before prompting the user to log out.", "Provide registered users with all E-store options regardless of their login time."]

requirement: The website must provide highest degree of security to the registered users. All the transactions that are made must be secured. The sensitive information passed to and from the website must be secured. Identity theft and other security related issues must be solved. Unauthorized transmission of sensitive information of the user to third party websites for reference must be avoided. On the basis of user agreement the information must be processed. All the information about the registered user must be securely stored in the central database.
title: Registered User Data and Transaction Security
description: As a registered user, I want the website to secure my transactions and personal data and process my information in accordance with our agreement, so that my sensitive information is protected from unauthorized disclosure and identity theft.
work_items: ["Secure all transactions conducted on the website.", "Secure all sensitive information transmitted to and from the website.", "Resolve identity theft and other security-related issues affecting registered users.", "Prevent unauthorized transmission of users' sensitive information to third-party websites for reference.", "Process user information strictly on the basis of the user agreement.", "Securely store all registered user information in the central database."]

requirement: Ensure the quality of the data by testing. Testing at least with race, gender, age should be done and variance between gropes should not be significant. Realtime testing in real context needs to be done before launch.
title: Data Quality Testing for Group Fairness
description: As a user, I want the data to be quality-tested for performance variance across race, gender, and age groups before launch, so that I can assess whether the system behaves comparably across those groups.
work_items: ["Data quality shall be ensured through testing.", "Testing shall cover, at minimum, the attributes race, gender, and age.", "Variance in results between the tested groups shall not be significant.", "Real-time testing in the real deployment context shall be completed before launch."]

requirement: The value add application the passenger is using needs to impelent a control which identifies, which data processing activities are necessary for which basic or added value services the user is considering to use and she can thus opt in or out of the service based on the data processed. The data the user has selected for her rights execution needs to be processed accordingly, e.g. anonymized, deleted or made available for the user to transfer to another service/download.
title: Service-Specific Data Processing Transparency and Opt-In/Opt-Out
description: As a passenger, I want to see which data processing activities are necessary for each basic or added-value service I am considering, so that I can opt in to or out of the service based on the data processed.
work_items: ["The application shall identify, for each basic or added-value service the passenger is considering, which data processing activities are necessary for that service.", "The passenger shall be able to opt in to or out of a service based on the data processing activities identified for it.", "Data the passenger has selected for the execution of her rights shall be processed accordingly, e.g. anonymized, deleted, or made available for the passenger to download or transfer to another service."]

requirement: Registered User must be able to maintain his/her session information for at least 60 minutes of inactive session before the system prompts him to log out of the system. The registered user must be provided with all the options of the E-store regardless of the time when he/she logs in.
title: Session Inactivity Duration and Time-Independent Store Access
description: As a registered user, I want my session retained during periods of inactivity and access to all e-store features regardless of when I log in, so that I can continue my activities without premature logouts or time-based restrictions on functionality.
work_items: ["Retain the registered user's session information for at least 60 minutes of inactivity before prompting to log out.", "Make all e-store options available to the registered user regardless of the time of login."]

requirement: Systems identifies users with special need and has feature to inform terminal service provider of required help. Systems also need to be available to tract special need aids inside the Terminal.
title: Support for Users with Special Needs
description: As a passenger with special needs, I want the system to inform the terminal service provider of the assistance I require, so that the required help can be provided.
work_items: ["The system shall identify users with special needs.", "The system shall provide a feature to inform the terminal service provider of the assistance required by a user with special needs.", "The system shall be available to track special-need aids inside the terminal."]

requirement: If the terminal interacts with smart vehicles, it must be in a way that does not compromise the safety of either party. There must be clear limits to what data is shared and what permissions the systems have for information exchange.
title: Safe Vehicle-Terminal Interaction and Data Exchange Limits
description: As a user, I want the terminal to enforce defined boundaries on data sharing and permissions when communicating with smart vehicles, so that the safety of either party is not compromised.
work_items: ["Ensure interactions between the terminal and smart vehicles do not compromise the safety of either party.", "Establish clear limits on the data shared between the terminal and smart vehicles.", "Define clear limits on system permissions for information exchange between the terminal and smart vehicles."]
